phrases.english: What do you think, should I apologize?

phrases.english: How can I make this right?

phrases.danish: Hvad er den bedste måde at bede om tilgivelse på?

phrases.english: Is it okay if we talk about this?
phrases.danish: Er det okay, hvis vi taler om det her?

phrases.english: Can you explain your feelings to me?

phrases.english: I want to understand your perspective.

phrases.english: Can you accept my sincere regret?

phrases.english: I value our relationship, you know.

phrases.danish: Kan vi blive enige om at være uenige, respektfuldt?
Du har lært en værdifuld lektion.

phrases.english: Kindness costs nothing, yet is priceless.

phrases.english: You are strong enough for this.
phrases.danish: Du er stærk nok til dette.

phrases.english: Give me some time, to think.

phrases.english: My feelings are still raw, you see.
phrases.danish: Mine følelser er stadig rå, du ved.

phrases.english: This is a chance, for renewal.

phrases.english: I let go, of what hurt me.
